description: Landscape I — Colore: Beach mint Collezione: Polpo Codice: 7079 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Landscape Altezza: 58.26 cm Toni: Light green Using the original machines still in operation at our Venice factory , we have developed n ew techniques that extend the processes established by Mariano Fortuny over a century ago to create a collection of fabric landscapes that recall the natural world . T he textiles of LANDSCAPE I stem from the patterns found in marble and on time-worn stone. Landscape I functions as a textile surface rather than a graphic motif. Its layered texture recalls stone shaped by time, lending interiors a quiet architectural presence and material depth. Part of the POLPO Collection .
